post.description: Exact registered tenant/workspace/project. Current owner and credential ceiling checked under locks. Role at most editor; no owner/admin/credential/grant delegation. Rotation only narrows immutable issued ceiling. Finite expiry, monotonically increasing version; hash-only link secret. New creates require a canonical UUIDv7 operationKey with immutable issuance timestamp within the fixed v1 30-day retry window (at most one minute future clock skew). Use NewGrantOperationKey and retain the original key/body. Configurable metadata retention cannot extend this immutable key validity. An expired key returns 410 even after metadata cleanup. Arbitrary legacy keys only replay matching retained receipts until their fixed 30-day expiry; they never admit a new create.
